description: Aviation worker chat-level hard stops — regex enforcement on AI text output. Covers all deployed aviation workers (CoPilot, Dispatch, MX). Structural FRAT/duty-time evals live in av_009/av_014 rulesets and are evaluated separately via validateOutput().

chat_rules.name: No dispatch clearance language
chat_rules.message: Aviation workers do not issue dispatch clearances or go/no-go decisions. A completed FRAT and dispatcher/PIC authorization are required before any mission proceeds.

chat_rules.name: No AI-generated V-speeds or aircraft limits
chat_rules.message: Aircraft-specific V-speeds and operating limits must be sourced from the operator's uploaded POH/AFM — not generated by AI. Upload your aircraft documents for serial-number-specific data.

chat_rules.name: PHI protection — medevac patient data
chat_rules.message: Patient health information (PHI) cannot appear in chat responses. Medevac clinical data must remain in protected HIPAA-compliant channels only.

chat_rules.name: No AI-fabricated fuel burn figures
chat_rules.message: Fuel calculations must be based on actual aircraft performance data from uploaded POH/flight-planning documents, not AI-generated estimates.

chat_rules.name: Duty time compliance assertion without data
chat_rules.message: Duty time assertions require actual numbers. State specific hours flown, cumulative duty periods, rest periods taken, and the applicable FAR part before asserting compliance.

chat_rules.name: MEL deferral without authority reference
chat_rules.message: MEL deferrals must reference the operator's FAA-approved MEL document and applicable category (A/B/C/D). Upload your MEL for specific deferral guidance.

disclaimer: Aviation analysis is advisory only. All go/no-go decisions, dispatch authority, and operational approvals rest with the Pilot-in-Command, dispatcher, and operator in accordance with applicable FARs and the operator's GOM/OpSpecs. AI-generated analysis does not substitute for approved aviation documents.
